No domestic supply record was seen.
note: Declared HS 880623 (aircraft parts) does NOT match any observed shipment line: the export rows seen are HS 85176990 (antennas/telecom parts) and the import rows are 85076000 (Li-ion batteries), 85437069 (RF modules) and 85261000 (radar). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground - the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to 85176990 (export) / 85076000-85437069-85261000 (import), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Profile fits an R&D / defence-electronics integrator in Chennai (Madipakkam address) buying radar, RF modules and batteries for development and re-exporting antenna hardware to Poland; counterparties include RFCORE (KR), TRON FUTURE TECH (TW), ITELITE ANTENNAS (PL), THEOS ENTERPRISE (TH). Export activity is confirmed by dated customs lines with B/L numbers, but the sample is small (2 export rows) and the bulk of the 216 records is paywalled - treat export volume as unquantified. Revenue and export value: null, not public in the free views. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources, but this is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because the registries were blocked, not because they were checked and empty.
